description: The most comprehensive domain assessment: DNS + mail security (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) + TLS + HTTP headers, scored. The only endpoint in this group that adds mail-security analysis. Use for a one-shot decision-grade verdict on an unfamiliar domain; use /dns/lookup, /ssl/check, /security/headers, /web/audit or /security/posture instead for a single fact or a cheaper signal.
name: post_domain_due_diligence
